name: Heavy
description: Heavy weapons require 10+ STR modifier to wield effortlessly. Otherwise, -4 to all attacks.

name: Super Heavy
description: Heavy weapons require 12+ STR modifier to wield effortlessly. Otherwise, -6 to all attacks.

name: Auto X
description: Allows for Full Auto Attack action.

name: Concealable
description: Gives +2 to conceal any equipment form any search electronic or physical.

name: Vac Suit X
description: Works in space, contains life support. X is the life support x12, so Vac Suit 2 is 24hrs of life support.

name: Zero-G
description: Weapon does not produce any recoil, can be used in <0.1g without any noticeable problems.

name: Complex Reload
description: Requires a complex reload skill to reload weapon in combat.

name: Normal
description: The most common form of NPC encountered. Regular goons. Will have 1-2 special features.

name: Elite
description: Slightly more rare to encounter. They are upgraded goons, police sergeants, or sicarios. Will have between 1-5 features.

name: Legendary
description: Very unique NPC's, usually vital to the story. Represents strong opponents, capable of outstanding feats. Can have any number of unique features attached.

name: Small
description: Targeting Small creatures give a -1 DM to hit

name: Medium
description: Average sized creature

name: Large
description: Targeting Large creatures give a +1 DM to hit

name: Ancient
description: A creation of the Ancients.

name: Walker
description: This creature is a walker, it walks on two legs.

name: Star Port A
description: Full facilities: shipyards, high-end services, naval bases, and interstellar banking.

name: Star Port B
description: Good quality: capable of construction and repair, with solid amenities and regular traffic.

name: Star Port C
description: Routine quality: unrefined fuel, supplies, and unskilled repair; often a frontier waystation.

name: Star Port D
description: Poor quality: little more than a marked landing zone, unrefined fuel, and a radio.

name: No Star Port
description: No facilities whatsoever; land at your own risk with no support.

name: Planet
description: A standard terrestrial world with gravity, atmosphere, and a solid surface.

name: Empty Space
description: Nothing but void; no planet, station, or feature—just coordinates in the black.

name: Space Station
description: An artificial habitat or platform orbiting a body or drifting free.

name: Asteroid
description: A rocky body, often mined, hollowed out, or barely large enough to land on.

name: Rouge Planet
description: A sunless world cast adrift between stars, frozen and lightless.

name: Polluted
description: Contaminated atmosphere, water, or soil; filters and hazard gear required.

name: Acid Rain
description: Corrosive precipitation that eats unprotected hull plating and flesh alike. Requires specialised hull plating and vac suits to withstand the corrosive effect.

name: Stormwracked
description: Wracked by permanent extreme weather; habitation is underground or shielded.

name: Dust Storm
description: Seasonal or perpetual particulate storms scour the surface, grounding aircraft and clogging every vent and seal.

name: Orbital Debris
description: A dense shell of wreckage and fragmented satellites makes approach hazardous; shields and careful navigation are mandatory.

name: Dangerous Wildlife
description: Native fauna is aggressively predatory, venomous, or territorial; outside the walls, you are prey.

name: Megafauna
description: Colossal creatures roam the landscape, capable of flattening settlements or crushing starships that set down in the wrong valley.

name: Volcanic Activity
description: Constant eruptions, lava flows, and toxic gas vents reshape the terrain daily; geothermal power is abundant but so is sudden death.

name: Food Shortage
description: The population cannot be sustained by local agriculture or imports; rationing is strict and starvation is a real threat.

name: Energy Crisis
description: Power generation is failing, outdated, or overtaxed; rolling blackouts cripple industry and life support teeters on the edge.

name: Water Scarcity
description: Potable water is vanishingly rare; what exists is tightly controlled, heavily recycled, or shipped in at ruinous cost.

name: Import Dependent
description: The system produces almost nothing of its own; basic necessities—from food to machine parts—must arrive by spaceliner.

name: Fuel Shortage
description: Refineries are dry, reserves are depleted, or the fuel is contaminated; ships are stranded and prices are extortionate.

name: Mining Boom
description: A valuable strike has triggered a gold-rush influx of prospectors, claim-jumpers, and speculators; the frontier is lawless and rich.

name: Dutch Disease
description: A single lucrative export has inflated costs and hollowed out all other industries; the economy is a one-legged stool.

name: Labor Shortage
description: There is more work than bodies; wages are sky-high, automation is patchy, and every ship brings recruiters rather than tourists.

name: Ethnic Tension
description: Competing cultural, species, or tribal factions are one spark away from open conflict; the streets are divided and armed.

name: Shipping Shortage
description: There are not enough hulls or merchants willing to call here; cargo sits in warehouses while captains chase better-paying routes.

name: Drug Shortage
description: Whether medicinal, anagathic, or recreational, the supply has dried up; withdrawal, black-market violence, and untreated illness follow.

name: Black Market
description: Official channels are choked by regulation, scarcity, or corruption; everything from rations to rifles moves through back rooms.

name: Agriworld
description: Vast plantations, orbital greenhouses, or engineered breadbaskets feed entire subsectors; the soil is the only thing that matters here.

name: Mining World
description: The crust has been flayed open by strip-mines, deep-core shafts, and orbital extractors; wealth flows out by the megaton.

name: Forge World
description: The sky glows with foundries and the ground shakes with manufactories; this planet builds the machines that run the empire.

name: Embargoed
description: The system is suffering from an embargo, all travel to and from the planet is strictly limited to pre approved personnel.

name: Red Zone
description: Interdicted; landing is legally prohibited due to extreme danger, active conflict, deadly plagues, dangerous alien artifacts or imperial edict.

name: Amber Zone
description: Hazardous; caution is advised -- conditions are risky but travel is not outright forbidden.

name: Quarantined
description: Biological or environmental lockdown; no entry or exit permitted under penalty.

name: Unexplored
description: No comprehensive survey exists; star charts may be wrong and the surface is largely unknown.

name: No Gravity
description: Zero-G throughout; freefall conditions require magnetic boots, thrusters, or tethering to navigate.

name: Low Gravity
description: Significantly less than standard; high jumps and fragile structures, with long-term health tolls on residents.

name: Medium Gravity
description: Comfortable standard range; roughly 0.8 to 1.2 G with no special accommodations needed.

name: High Gravity
description: Crushing weight; movement is exhausting, equipment strains, and hearts work overtime just to stand.

name: Independent
description: This system is largely independent from any foreign Empire.

name: Empty
description: Uninhabited. No permanent or temporary presence. Might be surveyed, might not.

name: Outpost
description: Small permanent or semi-permanent staff. Usually specific-purpose: research station, refueling depot, listening post, waystation. Population: dozens.

name: Settlement
description: Self-sustaining colony or homesteading community. Agriculture or resource extraction supports the population. Population: hundreds to low thousands.

name: Town
description: Multiple settlements linked by trade or a central township. Basic local government, maybe a sheriff or colonial administrator. Services exist (medical, repair, trade). Population: thousands to tens of thousands.

name: City
description: Multiple urban centers. Industrial or commercial hubs. Planetary government established. Spaceport likely handles regular traffic. Population: hundreds of thousands to millions.

name: Metropolis
description: Global urban network. Several major cities with suburbs and connecting infrastructure. Significant off-world trade. Population: tens of millions to billions.

name: Hive
description: Extreme urban density. Most or all habitable land developed. Arcologies, underground sprawl, or stacked cities. Population: tens of billions.

name: Ecumenopolis
description: Planet-wide city. The surface is entirely artificial. Requires massive import of food/resources or advanced synthesis. Population: hundreds of billions or more.

name: Ruins
description: A dead or dying world littered with the remains of a prior civilization; scavengers and archaeologists pick through the bones.

name: Freeport
description: Minimal regulation and no questions asked; a haven for independent traders, smugglers, and those who prefer no government oversight.

name: Criminal Haven
description: Lawless by design or corruption; gangs, syndicates, and fugitives operate openly and the authorities are either absent or bought.

name: Occupied
description: Under foreign military control; the local population lives under garrison rule, curfew, and the barrel of someone else's gun.

name: Naval Base
description: A significant military installation dominates the system; warships, troop carriers, and fleet logistics are the planet's primary purpose.

name: Trade Hub
description: A crossroads of commerce where multiple trade routes converge; markets, exchanges, and cargo handlers drive the entire economy.

name: Asteroid Belt
description: This system contains a series of asteroids grouped together into one large asteroid belt.

name: Ongoing Conflic
description: This world is an active warsone. Either through open war between major powers, or skimishing between the government and insurgents.

name: Feudal
description: Power held by landed nobles or warlords; high technology coexists with personal loyalty and sword-law.

name: Prison Colony
description: A colony forcibly settled by criminals from other worlds, left in this place to form a society of their own.\

name: Library World
description: This system is a data archive, university planet, or a reposityy of lost knowledge; scholars outnumber soldiers.

name: Major Power
description: This faction is a major player on the intergalactic scene.

name: Minor Power
description: This faction is a minor power, able to wield local power in the surronding systems.

name: Nomadic
description: No fixed territory; fleets, caravans, or migratory habitats.

name: Common
description: This weapon is increadibly common across the galaxy. Its as though everyone and their mother has one! Ammo can be found anywhere, and nobody bats an eye at your piece of metal.

name: Uncommon
description: A regional specialty or niche design. You won't see one on every street corner, but any serious arms merchant or planetary militia quartermaster knows exactly where to source one if you have the patience.

name: Rare
description: Limited production runs, specialist military contracts, or tech from a collapsed polity. Finding one requires knowing a guy who knows a guy. Ammo is specialized and must be ordered, smuggled, or fabricated to spec.

name: Unique
description: There is exactly one of these in existence. A custom commission, a drunken bet between engineers, or a quirk of history. Owning it makes you a legend; using it in public makes you a target for every collector and thief in the sector.

name: Xeno
description: Manufactured by a non-human species using principles that human engineers barely comprehend. Finding one requires journeying to alien space or dealing with xenotech smugglers. Human-compatible maintenance manuals simply don't exist.

name: Relic
description: Predates the modern interstellar order by centuries or millennia. Found in archaeological digs, noble armories, or the hands of cultists. Irreplaceable, historically priceless, and probably cursed according to at least three universities.

name: Fly
description: This creature has the ability to use its movement for flying.

name: AP X
description: Armour piercing. Reduce the target's armour by X when resolving damage from this attack.

name: Explosive X
description: This weapon delivers an explosive payload. Any target caught within X times 3 meters of the explosion suffers an automatic hit and takes damage equal to X D6.

name: Unreliable
description: This weapon is notorious unreliable! If you roll 2 dice with the same value on them you suffer a jam, requiring a reload action to clear! If your weapon is also Explosive, on a jam the explosive blows up in your face. Your attack does not count!

name: Stun
description: This weapon has a stunning effect on its victim! If you deliever stun damager equal to someones END they are knocked unconsiouce!

name: Armed
description: Carries turret or bay weaponry. Port authorities at high law levels will want the mounts sealed before docking.

name: Unarmed
description: No weapon hardpoints fitted. Cheap to insure, cheap to board.

name: Jump-1
description: Fitted with a Jump-1 drive: one parsec per week, the workhorse standard of the interstellar lanes.

name: Jump-2
description: Fitted with a Jump-2 drive. Twice the reach per jump, at considerable cost in fuel tankage and maintenance.

name: Jump-3
description: Fitted with a Jump-3 drive. Military couriers and the vessels of the very rich.

name: Smuggler Holds
description: Concealed compartments behind the cargo bulkheads. Gives a bonus to hide contraband from a customs sweep.

name: Transponder Spoofer
description: Illegal hardware that broadcasts a forged registration. Possession alone is a crime at Law 3 and above.

name: Derelict
description: Adrift and unpowered. Whatever happened aboard, nobody has filed a report.

name: Well Maintained
description: Kept to spec by a competent engineer. Fewer misjumps and fewer surprises.

name: Rustbucket
description: Held together by patches, prayer, and a creative maintenance log.

name: Highport
description: Orbital facility. Ships dock without ever entering atmosphere; passengers and cargo shuttle down.

name: Downport
description: Surface facility. Landing here means gravity wells, weather, and planetary customs.

name: Fortified
description: Hardened against attack: armoured bulkheads, defence batteries, and a garrison that drills.

name: Underground
description: Built below the surface, whether for shelter from the environment or from observation.

name: Domed
description: Sealed under a pressure dome. Atmosphere is a utility here, and it can be billed or cut off.

name: Black Market
description: Goods move here without manifests. Prices are negotiable; so is your safety.

name: Restricted Access
description: Credentials required. Turning up without them is trespass at best.

name: Medical Facility
description: Equipped for surgery and long-term care. Critical injuries can be properly treated here.

name: Fuel Depot
description: Refined fuel available for purchase. No skimming gas giants, no risk of misjump from dirty fuel.

name: Ruined
description: Abandoned and decaying. Structurally unsound, and whatever moved in after the people left is still there.
